en.headline: Police investigate death of 13-year-old girl found hanging in Yau Ma Tei flat
en.dek: A mother reported finding her daughter hanging in a room at a Nathan Road building on Tuesday evening; the girl was confirmed dead at the scene and a note was recovered.
body: Police are investigating the death of a 13-year-old girl found hanging in a flat in Yau Ma Tei on Tuesday evening.

Officers received a report at about 9.44pm from a woman who said she had discovered her daughter hanging in a room at a unit in Mong Kok Building, 546 Nathan Road, and had taken her down. Police and ambulance personnel confirmed the girl was dead at the scene.
Initial inquiries suggest a nylon rope was used. A note was found at the scene. The cause of death is subject to a post-mortem examination. Police said the case remains under investigation.
Authorities reminded members of the public that support is available through hotlines including the Samaritans (2896 0000) and government mental-health services.

zh.headline: 油麻地13歲女童寓所內上吊死亡 警方調查
zh.dek: 周二晚上約9時44分，母親報稱在彌敦道旺角大樓單位房間發現女兒上吊並將她解下；女童當場證實死亡，現場檢獲遺書。
body: 警方正調查一名13歲女童周二晚上在油麻地寓所內上吊死亡的事件。
警方於晚上約9時44分接獲一名女子報案，指在彌敦道546號旺角大樓一個單位的房間內發現其13歲女兒上吊，她已將女兒解下。警方及救護人員到場後，證實女童當場死亡。
初步調查顯示，女童懷疑以尼龍繩上吊，現場檢獲遺書。死因有待驗屍確定。警方表示案件仍在調查中。
當局提醒市民，如有情緒困擾可致電撒瑪利亞會熱線28960000或使用政府精神健康支援服務求助。
